title.zh: 修订第74号法案的法案，该法案设立公共教育部，并经第477号与第525号法案修正，本次修订增置教育总督导助理职位、将学区数量减至三十五个、规定教育总督导、教育总督导助理及学区督导的差旅费用，并作其他规定
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED SEVENTY-FOUR, ESTABLISHING A DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC INSTRUCTION, AS AMENDED BY ACTS NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED AND SEVENTY- SEVEN AND FIVE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-FIVE, BY PROVIDING FOR AN ASSISTANT TO THE GENERAL SUPERINTENDENT OF EDUCATION, FOR THE REDUCTION OF THE NUMBER OF SCHOOL DIVISIONS TO THIRTY-FIVE, FOR THE TRAVELING EXPENSES OF THE GENERAL SUPERINTENDENT, ASSISTANT TO THE GENERAL SUPERINTENDENT, AND DIVISION SUPERINTENDENTS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED SEVENTY-FOUR, ESTABLISHING A DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC INSTRUCTION, AS AMENDED BY ACTS NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED AND SEVENTY- SEVEN AND FIVE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-FIVE, BY PROVIDING FOR AN ASSISTANT TO THE GENERAL SUPERINTENDENT OF EDUCATION, FOR THE REDUCTION OF THE NUMBER OF SCHOOL DIVISIONS TO THIRTY-FIVE, FOR THE TRAVELING EXPENSES OF THE GENERAL SUPERINTENDENT, ASSISTANT TO THE GENERAL SUPERINTENDENT, AND DIVISION SUPERINTENDENTS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật Số Bảy Mươi Bốn thành lập Bộ Giáo dục Công cộng, đã được sửa đổi bởi Đạo luật Số Bốn Trăm Bảy Mươi Bảy và Đạo luật Số Năm Trăm Hai Mươi Lăm, bằng cách bổ nhiệm Trợ lý Tổng Giám đốc Giáo dục, giảm số Phòng Giáo dục xuống ba mươi lăm, quy định chi phí đi lại của Tổng Giám đốc Giáo dục, Trợ lý Tổng Giám đốc Giáo dục và Giám đốc Phòng Giáo dục, và các quy định khác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่เจ็ดสิบสี่ซึ่งจัดตั้งกรมการศึกษาสาธารณะและได้รับการแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมโดยพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่สี่ร้อยเจ็ดสิบเจ็ดและพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ห้าร้อยยี่สิบห้าโดยกำหนดให้มีผู้ช่วยผู้อำนวยการการศึกษาทั่วไปลดจำนวนเขตการศึกษาให้เหลือสามสิบห้าเขตกำหนดค่าใช้จ่ายในการเดินทางของผู้อำนวยการการศึกษาทั่วไปผู้ช่วยผู้อำนวยการการศึกษาทั่วไปและผู้อำนวยการเขตการศึกษาและวัตถุประสงค์อื่น
title.id: Undang-Undang yang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor Tujuh Puluh Empat yang mendirikan Departemen Pendidikan Umum sebagaimana telah diubah oleh Undang-Undang Nomor Empat Ratus Tujuh Puluh Tujuh dan Undang-Undang Nomor Lima Ratus Dua Puluh Lima dengan menyediakan asisten Direktur Jenderal Pendidikan, pengurangan jumlah divisi sekolah menjadi tiga puluh lima, biaya perjalanan Direktur Jenderal Pendidikan, asisten Direktur Jenderal Pendidikan, dan inspektur divisi sekolah, serta hal lainnya
title.ms: Akta yang mengubah Akta Nombor Tujuh Puluh Empat yang menubuhkan Jabatan Pendidikan Awam sebagaimana telah diubah oleh Akta Nombor Empat Ratus Tujuh Puluh Tujuh dan Akta Nombor Lima Ratus Dua Puluh Lima dengan menyediakan pembantu Ketua Pengarah Pendidikan pengurangan bilangan bahagian sekolah kepada tiga puluh lima peruntukan perbelanjaan perjalanan Ketua Pengarah Pendidikan pembantu Ketua Pengarah Pendidikan dan pengarah bahagian sekolah dan tujuan-tujuan lain

text.en:
Act Numbered Seventy-four, as amended by Acts Numbered Four hundred and seventy-seven and
five hundred and twenty-five, is hereby amended as follows:
(a) By making paragraph (b) of section three read as follows:
"(b) He shall appoint, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Public Instruction, an assistant
to the General Superintendent of Education, at an annual salary of two thousand four hundred
dollars, payable monthly, and shall prescribe the duties of said assistant. He shall also appoint,
subject to the approval of the Secretary of Public Instruction, a city superintendent of schools
for Manila and division superintendents of schools for other parts of the Archipelago at the
salaries hereinafter provided, and the teachers and clerks authorized by law, and shall prescribe
the duties of such teachers and clerks."
(b) By making section five read as follows:
"Section 5. The Archipelago shall be and is hereby divided into thirty-five school
divisions. In the First Division (the city of Manila and its barrios) there shall be a
city superintendent of schools, and in each of the other divisions, except the
Thirty-second, Thirty-third, Thirty-fourth, and Thirty-fifth, there shall be a
regularly appointed division superintendent. The divisions and the annual salaries
of the superintendents thereof shall he as follows:

"First Division, the city of Manila and its barrios, three thousand dollars.
"Second Division, Albay and Sorsogon, one thousand eight hundred
"Third Division, Ambos Camarines, two thousand dollars.
"Fourth Division, Batangas, two thousand dollars.
"Fifth Division, Bohol, two thousand dollars up to July first, nineteen
hundred and three, and on and after that date one thousand eight hundred
"Sixth Division, Bulacan, one thousand six hundred dollars.
"Seventh Division, Cagayan and Isabela, two thousand two hundred and
fifty dollars.
"Eighth Division, Capiz, one thousand five hundred dollars.
"Ninth Division, Cavite, one thousand six hundred dollars.
"Tenth Division, Cebu, two thousand two hundred and fifty dollars.
"Eleventh Division, Ilocos Norte, two thousand dollars.
"Twelfth Division, Ilocos Sur and Abra, two thousand two hundred and
fifty dollars.
"Thirteenth Division, Iloilo and Antique, two thousand five hundred
"Fourteenth Division, La Laguna, one thousand eight hundred dollars.
"Fifteenth Division, La Union, one thousand five, hundred dollars.
"Sixteenth Division, Leyte and Samar, two thousand four hundred dollars.
"Seventeenth Division, Masbate, one thousand five hundred dollars.
"Eighteenth Division, Mindanao and Job (with the exception of Misamis
and Surigao), two thousand five hundred dollars.
"Nineteenth Division, Misamis, one thousand five hundred dollars.
"Twentieth Division, Nueva Ecija, two thousand dollars.
"Twenty-first Division, Nueva Vizcaya, one thousand five hundred dollars.
"Twenty-second Division, Occidental Negros, two thousand two hundred
and fifty dollars.

"Twenty-third Division, Oriental Negros, one thousand six hundred
"Twenty-fourth Division, Pampanga and Bataan, two thousand two
hundred and fifty dollars.
"Twenty-fifth Division, Pangasinan, two thousand five hundred dollars.
"Twenty-sixth Division, Rizal, one thousand five hundred dollars.
"Twenty-seventh Division, Romblon, one thousand five hundred dollars.
"Twenty-eighth Division, Surigao, one thousand five hundred dollars.
"Twenty-ninth Division, Tarlac, one thousand five hundred dollars.
"Thirtieth Division, Tayabas, two thousand dollars.
"Thirty-first Division, Zambales, one thousand five hundred dollars.
"In the Thirty-second, Thirty-third, Thirty-fourth, and Thirty-fifth Divisions,
comprising the Provinces of Mindoro, Benguet, Lepanto-Bontoc, and Paragua.
the respective governors shall act, without additional compensation, as division
superintendents: Provided, That for school purposes the entire Island of Paragua
shall constitute the school division under the supervision of the governor of the
Province of Paragua."
